_doc: HARVESTED PRIOR DECISIONS — the input manifest for scripts/build-prior-decisions.mjs. Each row records WHAT was decided, WHERE (file:line) and WHEN, plus the probes that MEASURE whether it is true in the working tree today. This file never records status; status is computed every run. Edit this file and re-run `node scripts/build-prior-decisions.mjs`; never hand-edit the emitted ledger. Probe roles: `ship` (decides shipped/partial/never) and `contradiction` (a passing contradiction probe forces status=contradicted). A probe whose repo/file is absent reports UNMEASURABLE and is excluded from the ratio rather than silently scored as a failure.

Extend the absolute fact gate to the audio narration JSON the renderer speaks verbatim — a language-aware gate over every audio.<lang>.json.
Bring the product's transactional + digest email under the banned-phrase and reading-grade gates, and machine-check the es-MX tuteo register.
Machine-block the fake-team 'our team / our engineers' voice on the storefront's own marketing surfaces — the mirror of the product's 'Don' check.

PROPOSAL: mirror sourced-claims.json for pictures — data/image-credits.json plus scripts/check-image-credits.mjs wired into check-all, or photographs are not admitted.
PROPOSAL: recognise a third visual lane — literal illustrations authored as SVG/HTML and rendered to images at build time, reusing the OG-card render pipeline.

Cold storage reads as a same-month deviation from the trailing 5-year same-month median, emits null on thin history, and only pork (labelled coincident) and butter cast a directional vote.

The Cost Index becomes partly a data company and an open-source library: events, yields, seasonality, lock-or-float and anomaly datasets ship as explorable surfaces AND downloadable open datasets under an explicit per-file CC0/CC-BY split; co-movement is directed, bounded, anchored — co-occurrence, never cause.

Founder directive — make Vendor Benchmark rival the biggest SaaS companies in power, UX and cutting-edge feel WITHIN the honest / on-device / no-backend / private-prices moat. Everything stays static HTML + vanilla JS, dual-locale, honesty-gated.
Rank 1 — mobile floor: 16px inputs (kill iOS zoom-on-focus) and a --vb-touch:44px target token applied to every control, clearing WCAG 2.5.5.
Rank 2 — shard the 360KB history seed into one ~6KB file per item (data/ci-history/<item>.js), load only the picked item's shard, add an immutable cache rule and intent-gated prefetch.
Rank 3 — a render-epoch motion gate plus unified --vb-* motion tokens: animate on identity change, SNAP on keystroke recompute. Hard prerequisite for any signature motion.
Rank 4 — journal history spine: a capped newest-first ring per key instead of overwrite, so 'since your last check' reads durable storage rather than an in-memory variable lost on refresh.

Rank 5 — wire the loaded-but-never-read MUNTIN_COST_CONTEXT into a neutral ADR-012 context line, and mine the on-device 3-year series for an honest same-calendar-period seasonality baseline that withholds under two clean prior years.

Rank 6 — accessibility core: a real <h2> verdict heading reachable by heading navigation, aria-describedby on the bad-price hint, and an SVG aria-label built from the chart model so a blind user HEARS the withhold a sighted user sees.

Rank 7 — the differentiated centrepiece: a live 'Prices on this device: N · Requests carrying them: 0' readout where the 0 is measured by a fetch/XHR/sendBeacon shim, plus a four-cell provenance nutrition strip (SOURCE / BASIS / AS OF / SCOPE) before the input.

Rank 8 — first-run aha: a singular 'See it work →' CTA, a ghost/skeleton readout using em-dashes never numerals, and a three-scenario switcher whose third scenario is 'Thin data — we hold the call', so onboarding demos the withhold.

Rank 9 — activate memory: a 'while you were away' cold-load re-read of the wholesale reference's move since each journal entry, a pinned 'Your items' group in the picker, and vendor/volume recall on reopen.

Rank 10 — power-user layer: paste-a-table, Enter-to-advance, single-key shortcuts, a '?' sheet, and a VB-scoped ⌘K palette registered in the capture phase so the site-wide Pagefind ⌘K is untouched elsewhere.
Rank 11 — Your Book dashboard: a sortable portfolio table with per-item sparklines, a book-level header, drill-to-source, and an earned significance read that can only ever make VB more cautious.
Rank 12 — signature motion: draw the divergence open via stroke-dashoffset, tween the hero gap, native view transitions — all gated on the rank-3 epoch flag, with no wedge when the data is thin.

Rank 13 — a URL-fragment share codec storing integer cents, inbound hydration, a privacy-graduated 'Copy link' with the honest 'anyone you send this to can read these prices' disclosure, and local export/import.
Rank 14 — field + offline finish: navigator.share, a sticky thumb-arc verdict chip, a legible mobile chart, and an installable offline PWA caching only own static files and public shards.

Rank 15 — craft + conformance capstone: tactile :active states, --vb-signal formalised as the 'instrument is live' colour kept strictly separate from verdict tones, direction glyphs so over/under is never colour-only, a density mode, and a published a11y statement locked by a CI gate.

REJECTED for the moat, with an honest on-device alternative recorded for each: account-based cross-device sync; server-rendered per-link OG unfurls; a crowd-sourced vendor price database; server-side usage/price analytics and cloud email of the brief; realtime multiplayer; runtime cloud TTS/AI narration and server-side PDF.

Non-negotiable — the demo's immutable numbers stay byte-intact ($24.10/$24.35/$29.45, median $24.22, ▲$5.23/+21.6%, $115.80, '$19 a month per location'), every artifact is labelled illustrative, and the FLOOR holds: no internal scroll, no page bounce, no horizontal overflow across the viewport matrix.

decisions.decision: Rung 0 (do this Monday) — write scripts/check-src-sentinel.mjs, promoting the <!-- src: --> comment convention to an enforced, MONOTONE-DOWNWARD sentinel: on disagreement it may stamp as-of, freeze the citation, or flag superseded, and may never restate a number upward or author prose.

Rung 0 — delete 'the certified conformal band' from data/cost-lockfloat.json AND data/cost-lockfloat.js (the .js is loaded by es/tools/cost-pulse, so the overclaim ships to browsers today), replacing it with the backtested band and its realized 0.767 pooled coverage.

Build it in July, publish it at the launch announcement window.

Rung 2 — scripts/check-confidence-ceiling.mjs: a machine may only ever LOWER a published confidence label or descriptive adjective to match its measured record; raising one requires a human. If it can only be written by loosening another gate, the rung dies, not the gate.

Rung 3 — name the valuation rung beside every food-cost % in Ledger (override / WAC / prior-count carry / Cost-Index market prior / withheld), and wire the vendor-cost-index re-vendoring into CI so the 30-day fail-closed window stops being an open thread.

MUST STAY TRUE #1 — the fact gate is absolute and no rung may loosen it. If a rung requires a waiver, an undated allowlist entry or a gate exception to ship, the rung dies, not the gate.

MUST STAY TRUE #2 — machines may only LOWER a claim. Any automation touching published confidence, labels, adjectives or numbers may withhold, cap, demote or stamp-as-of; raising a claim requires a human plus a source.
MUST STAY TRUE #3 — published prose is bound to its cited source: every <!-- src: --> resolves, and disagreement triggers demotion, never silent restatement.
MUST STAY TRUE #4 — no timestamp is ever constructed. revisedAt is forward-only; historical rows are null with a stated reason. Inferring a publication date from git history is fabrication.

MUST STAY TRUE #5 — no language model touches a customer number, and the gate must live where the model would. no-llm-ci.sh exists only in the product repo; before any agent-facing storefront work, PORT IT, plus an import-boundary gate.
MUST STAY TRUE #6 — never an LLM judge, anywhere in any scoring or acceptance path. It would make every gate feel stronger while being strictly weaker, silently.
MUST STAY TRUE #7 — no forecast, ever. Direction beats baseline only at h=1 by +0.004 and is worse than a coin flip beyond. Withholding the forecast IS the product.

MUST STAY TRUE #8 — the confidence label is a PROVENANCE descriptor, not a skill claim (scoreSeparatesSkill: false), and any machine-readable object carrying it must carry that marker in the same object or must not carry the label.
MUST STAY TRUE #9 — every accuracy figure ships with its n and its answer rate. Abstention must never be able to flatter a number, and n=2 must never headline.
MUST STAY TRUE #10 — absence reasons are 'searched and did not find', never 'does not exist', and no machine ever authors one.

The viral post's two unsourced headline statistics (a bonus figure and a productivity-uplift percentage, both quoted only inside the strategy review that bars them) are BARRED from the rest of this repo entirely — not in an ADR, not on the resume-here board, not as motivating context. The volatility firewall (non-negotiable) — the corpus↔index gate reads ONLY the map, the key list and filesystem existence. It must never read a level, trend, flag or confidence, so a Mon/Wed/Fri refresh can never redden a local check-all run.

The outward-facing live-value-in-article version is mechanically possible and we are NOT doing it: it would freeze stale cents into committed /library/ HTML that no gate re-verifies, creating a fact-gate surface where a number in committed prose has no gate tying it to data. A hand-placed <a href> carries no value and no (idem) question.

GOVERNING RULE — this system produces a REVIEW QUEUE, never a verdict. It may say 'the ground truth under this article has moved, a human should look'; it may never assert an article is wrong, auto-edit prose, present co-occurrence as cause, or publish a machine-made claim.

A scanner is only as good as its root list — declare roots, justify omissions. A script that scans the site walks EVERYTHING and carries an explicit skip list where every entry says why it is not reader-facing prose. Learned three times in one day, each time by shipping the bug first.

Never resolve a FAILING unwired gate by wiring it — check-all runs inside the Cloudflare deploy command, so wiring a currently-failing gate turns every deploy red. Fix the violations first, then wire, then delete the UNWIRED entry.
Slugs are final-forever. Renaming a post breaks deep links from smart-next blocks, external citations and AI Overview rotation. To revise content, rewrite in place and bump dateModified.

The absolute fact gate: every number, date, name, anecdote and percentage must be registered in sourced-claims.json, cited inline via <details class="cite">, or labelled illustrative in the prose. Zero inventions.
